items.q: What happens after I use my 200 AI minutes?
items.a: Your 200 AI minutes refresh every month — unused minutes don't roll over. If you run out, AI features pause until the next month, but you can keep recording and everything stays saved on the device.
Most orders arrive within 5–10 business days in the US and Asia-Pacific, and 7–12 business days in Europe. Exact estimates are shown at checkout.
